g.text: Participation correlates are strongest in the municipal election

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Open Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #727272

g.text: Across 583 census tracts, the same social gradients recur—but their strength depends on the election.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Open Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1e3765
font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Open Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #007fa3

g.text: Recent-immigrant share attenuates from municipal (−0.46) to federal (−0.08); condominium share changes sign (−0.08 to +0.21).

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Open Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #727272

g.text: Each estimate is a bivariate, ecological association—not an individual-level or causal effect. Pairwise n = 583 CTs.
